title: Hidden F-117 stealth fighter line in the DOE budget

tellings.quote: >> It was the F-17 fighter >> being developed. our first um fighter that was undetectable by radar and it was based in the energy department land in the Nevada desert

plain: In the 1980s, America's first radar-proof fighter jet, the F-117 stealth fighter, was being built in secret on Energy Department land in the Nevada desert, its cost tucked away in the Energy Department budget. That is what John S. Herrington, who was Secretary of Energy then, tells Michels from his own time in office. He calls it "the F-17 fighter," "our first um fighter that was undetectable by radar," and his story shows how a secret aircraft could be hidden inside an unrelated department's books.
